scope: One integrated-model load, three owned short direct-scoring cases, and one native greedy continuation. 16K execution was not attempted in this run.

model.label: integrated_candidate
model.execution: Custom Qwen3.5 candidate on the AMD RyzenAI NPU provider, including CPU graph components; no GPU provider configured.

runtime_provider.verification_scope: The package-pinned installed DLL hash was rechecked while building this evidence; it is not an independent loaded-module attestation.

transaction_archive.coverage_kind: Complete installed SDK archive; no transaction filtering

package.config_redaction: Only the absolute dd_cache value is replaced with <package>/cache. The exact original config SHA-256 is retained.

stage_snapshot_status_note: The preflight/model-loaded snapshots retain the runner's initial 'failed' sentinel before finalization; neither records an exception. Final report status is short_only_passed.

result.readout: OGA native full-vocabulary last-position logits restricted to declared answer slots; no generated tokens
result.probability_status: conditional option score; uncalibrated as decision confidence

eager_baseline_comparison.scope: Exact equality of the three recorded two-option logit pairs, probabilities, option IDs and prompt/tokenization identities. Full-vocabulary arrays were not preserved, so full-vocabulary equality is not claimed. Timings are excluded.

native_greedy_continuation.cache_mode: native OGA Generator append_tokens/generate_next_token; no external recurrent-state inputs
native_greedy_continuation.qualification: EOS termination was observed only for this short continuation; no general long-context EOS guarantee is inferred.

npu_activity.context_label_scope: Stable relative aliases within this run; original context IDs and process IDs are omitted.

assumptions: The initial prefill supplies the first generated token; the remaining three tokens require three native autoregressive decode forwards.
The greedy request reuses the first direct case's exact 94-token prompt and incurs the same observed prefill increments: context_0=962, context_1=48, context_2=112, context_3=0.
Context counters identify runtime contexts, not individual graph operators; matching residual counts is consistency evidence, not a per-node execution trace.

timing.qualification: One cold integrated run, including initial compilation of 273 DD metadata files; these timings are not a repeated speed benchmark.

supervisor.policy: 2 consecutive 3s CPU<=30%, available RAM>=32GiB, build process count=0
supervisor.memory_qualification: Committed process/job virtual memory only; driver/NPU allocations and physical RAM are not fully bounded

artifact_identity.hash_scope: Package hashes are materialization evidence. The short-run backend recorded hashes for 284 existing package artifacts and 1092 runtime-compiled artifacts. It did not rehash the 996 original .const inputs; their manifest SHA-256 values and checked file sizes are retained. This CPU publication step did not reread weight/compiled-constant data.

limitations: This is a custom Qwen3.5 conversion, not an AMD-published or SDK-supported Qwen3.5 model.
16K prompt ingestion, long-prefix recurrent-state behavior and long generation remain unverified; config ceiling/search limits are not validation evidence.
Three owned color questions are functional sanity checks, not model-quality or general accuracy benchmarks.
Finite-logit checks observed seven last-position vectors of 248320 entries, but full-vocabulary values were not saved for numerical comparison.
Native OGA recurrent state was managed internally. This short run does not independently validate every state update or establish long-context equivalence.
NPU activity counters and dispatch-count consistency do not prove all graph operations ran on NPU; CPU graph components are part of this configuration.
Committed process/job virtual memory only; driver/NPU allocations and physical RAM are not fully bounded
